purpose: Optional deterministic visual diagnostics without changing policy, plant or referee contracts.

implementation.top_view: RGB uint8 raster with static segments, dynamic target geometry, heading and valid/invalid rays
implementation.doom_2_5d: RGB uint8 column projection with perpendicular-distance correction and depth shading
implementation.display: Matplotlib is lazy-imported only by show_top_view/show_doom

guarantees: Headless render functions require no GUI backend.
Equal pose, geometry and observation inputs produce byte-identical images.
Doom projection samples only a bounded frontal FOV and never projects rear beams.
Invalid or blind beams are not rendered as observed walls.
Visualizers do not call the plant or referee and do not mutate policy-visible state.
No target identity is inferred from sensor ranges.
limitations: Doom mode is 2.5D planar diagnostics, not a calibrated 3D Livox renderer.
The visualizer does not certify visibility, collision safety or physical sensor calibration.
Interactive keyboard control is intentionally not included in the safety testbed; actuation must continue through the accepted command boundary.
